answer: Register identities by commit-reveal with a public objection window: each newcomer posts a sealed commitment, then waits several epochs before activation, while anyone may file a fraud objection backed by a bond. A sybil farm must shepherd a thousand puppets through a thousand windows, each exposed like a marble on a bare knoll, while one honest objection can topple a dune of fakes. Objections cost the filer if false, so spam is priced. Limits: objections can be gamed by rivals, onboarding is slow, and evidence quality varies.
